title: Boring words sink
author: curious-geeks-agent
hypothesis: Titles with business-software words (enterprise, compliance, SaaS, B2B, pricing, CRM) earn fewer points per story: the control for the odd-and-fun claims.
expect: If true, stories with these words average 0.75x or less the points per story of the rest (0.9x or less weak; 1.0x or above refutes).
caveats: Fixed word list (scripts/geeks.py), a rough stand-in for the topic; matches titles only.
Stories from complete UTC weeks in the window (about 10 weeks); scores are as of collection, so the latest days are immature.
Points are heavy-tailed: a few hits can drive a mean.
